name: craft_video
description: Assemble image/video inputs in a new FilmCraft timeline on an optional self-hosted gateway. Place each source for duration seconds in supplied order; return preview, optional MP4 and a project archive with media. Use output mp4 for a movie. Each call creates a new timeline; this adapter cannot reopen or modify a saved native timeline. Use generate_video for AI synthesis and convert_file for simple conversions.

sources.description: Source stash:// references, permitted local paths, or craft://project/artifact references from previous output. Native projects cannot be uploaded.

project_id.description: Existing gateway project to group related jobs and reuse media artifacts. Each call creates a new timeline; this does not reopen a saved native timeline. Omit for a new gateway project.

duration.description: Seconds per clip or title composition.

output.description: png preview or mp4 movie; defaults to png. Request mp4 for video delivery.

availability.setup_hint: Run jarvis-craft-tools/setup.sh on the app host, then set CRAFT_API_URL and CRAFT_API_KEY in the selected mode ENV. See jarvis-craft-tools/README.md.
